svg.title: Permission comes before execution
svg.desc: An inspection line with independent validation and authority latches. Reject with a typed error. Do not improvise around policy.
svg.text: The model proposes an operation and arguments.
Check the schema and semantics, then whether this user is authorized.
Obtain approval when required. Execute with an idempotency strategy appropriate to
